description:
The authoritative benchmark qualification artifact of one immutable run bundle. Present if and only if `qualification_mode=benchmark_qualified`; a generic ArchLens analysis carries no qualification object at all, and its absence in such a run is correct rather than missing.

What this document is authoritative FOR: repository representativeness, benchmark admission, stable qualification reason codes, and adjudication provenance. What it is NOT authoritative for, and may never modify: `analysis.json`, inventories, contributions, callables, metric populations, metric values, and every `*_status` field. Measurement authority stays exactly where Artifact 1.10 left it.

Three of the fields on each record - `usable_metric_families`, `benchmark_usability` and `repository_level_comparison_eligible` - are PERSISTED CHECKED DERIVATIONS. They are computed from the authoritative measurement statuses plus the accepted representativeness verdict and any manual restriction, never read from registry input, and a persisted value that disagrees with its derivation is a semantic validation failure rather than an override.

The artifact holds exactly one record per executed repository, including for subjects whose registry entry was absent, stale or identity-mismatched: those become explicit UNRESOLVED records. Preserving cardinality is what makes a readiness blocker visible instead of silent.

qualification_profile.description: The single profile every record in this artifact was decided under.

registry_provenance.description: Which accepted registry bytes produced these records. A qualification decision cannot be attached to a finalized run after the fact: changing the registry requires producing a new run bundle with a new manifest binding.

title: ArchLens benchmark qualification 1.0

binding.description: Exactly the primary identity. Must equal the matching `analysis.json` result's identity field for field; a near match is not a match.

qualification_status.description: `adjudicated` requires an exact registry match carrying accepted human/forensic provenance. `unresolved` is emitted for a missing, stale or identity-mismatched entry and carries no fabricated adjudicator.

usable_metric_families.description: DERIVED, in fixed contract order, from the authoritative per-metric statuses alone. A family is included when its status is `complete` or `partial`. Membership never upgrades a partial observation: the original status remains the authority on completeness.

benchmark_usability.description: DERIVED. Null when aggregate measurement failed, or when a partial measurement yields no usable family at all - mapping either case onto `unsupported_scope` would conflate measurement failure with scope and admission.

repository_level_comparison_eligible.description: STRICTLY DERIVED, never an input. Persisted only for consumer convenience. Final unrestricted benchmark-of-record permission additionally requires the run-level readiness verdict, which is deliberately NOT folded into this per-record field: an exploratory run can hold correctly qualified records without being a benchmark of record.

evidence_summary.description: Evidence carried forward from the accepted decision. Permissive here, unlike the registry's own strict form, because this is a faithful copy of accepted evidence rather than a place where new evidence is authored.

adjudication.description: Accepted provenance, or null for an `unresolved` record. Null is the ONLY correct value there: synthesizing an adjudicator for a decision nobody made is the specific failure this field's nullability exists to prevent.

representativeness_basis.description: NON-SEMANTIC evidence text. Never a gate, join, count or comparison key.
